 'H': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*eps**(p[3]+p[4]*T)+p[5]*eps*T,
 'I': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.log(eps+p[2])*(p[3]+p[4]*T)+p[5]*eps,
